verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for cap-table SaaS, so the story applies, but the evidence shows no conversational or NL command interface. Every documented workflow is click-driven UI (e.g. Actions → Terminate Stakeholder). The Term Sheet Scanner summarizes uploaded documents rather than taking commands, and the llms.txt probe only exposes help-center content to LLMs; neither lets a user operate the product in natural language.
